notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
It is your turn.
description:
Activate the Goblin sacrifice outlet by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin sacrifice outlet ability.
Repeat.
This combo will provide infinite results of whatever the Goblin sacrifice outlet produces, which will vary depending on the sacrifice outlet used.
